method: Citations are relative to android/jadx-out/sources/ (default jadx output); facts marked (simple-mode) were read from `jadx --decompilation-mode simple --show-bad-code --no-imports --no-res -d /tmp/net-simple/out android/xapk/de.jung.junghome.apk` because the default output skips those coroutine bodies (line numbers still cite the default output). Starting points docs/android/network-logic.md, docs/gap-analysis/network-features.md, docs/hidden-features.md were re-checked against the source; every apk_ref was machine-validated (file exists, line <= file length). ENUMERATION (closed, rerunnable): (1) net:uc:<class lowercase> - every class extending UseCase or FlowUseCase (grep -lE 'extends (UseCase|FlowUseCase)') that is a top-level (no '$') file in de/jung/junghome/domain/interactors/{binaryInputAssignment,cloud,configuration,connection,detector,elementConnectionGroups,gateway,gateway/permissions,group,keyAssignment,networking,project,scene,schedules,timer,user}; plus the explicit allow-list top-level {CreateProjectFile,KeepLowPowerDeviceAwake,RemoveInvalidDevices,RemoveLocalData,ResetNetwork,CheckForValidProject,ObserveProjectBubbleIndicators,ObserveGatewayPermissionsIndicator}, devices/{AddGroupToDevices,DeleteGroupFromDevices,UpdateDeviceData,UpdateDeviceInfo}, manufacturer/{CommunicateWithDevice,RequestManufacturerInfos,UpdateDeviceTypeGroup}. Out of domain (not enumerated): packages config, demo, forceAppUpdate, update, base, devices/provisioning; top-level CheckForInternetConnection, CheckNewUserModeBanner, ObserveBluetoothState, ObserveDeviceConnectionState, ObserveProject, ToggleFavorite, UpdateConnectionInterval; devices/{ObserveDevice,ObserveDeviceInfo,ObserveDevices,RequestSoftwareVersion,RequestUnknownSoftwareVersionForUpdates,ScanUnprovisionedDevices,ToggleDevice} (control/provisioning/firmware domains). The first apk_ref of every uc/svc item is the class declaration line (regex '\b(class|interface|enum) <Name>\b'). (2) net:svc:<class> - non-UseCase service classes with network logic in the same packages: TimeKeeperConfiguration, EnsureTimeKeeper, ImportProjectWhenNewSyncIsAvailable, CloudOfflineDialogServiceImpl, UserRoleServiceImpl, DeviceSetupServiceImpl, NoProvisionerErrorChannel. Other non-UseCase classes there are either mapped to net:enum items (BinaryInputAssignment, BinaryInputNumber, OfflineDialogType, *Step, LockingFunction, RtrConnectionMode, CloudImportStatusChannel, ImportExportCoordinator, JHSchedule, ControlSwitchKeyAssignment, ControlSwitchKeyPosition, TimeKeeperEvent, DeviceFilter, SleepMode) or excluded by name regex '(Error|Exception|Kt|Filter|Service)$|^[a-z]$|^CouldNotFindSuitableTimeKeeper$'. A generator check asserts every class selected by (1)/(2) has an item. (3) net:cfg:<opcode hex> / net:proxycfg:<opcode> - every Config*/ProxyConfig* message class in no/nordicsemi/android/mesh/transport that is not a Status/List/State class; 'grep -rlw <Class> sources | grep -v /no/nordicsemi/' decides used (builder cited) vs never used (item says so - this is how heartbeat, friend, node identity, unbind, virtual address, NetKey add/delete, subscription overwrite/delete-all are recorded as absent). Opcodes from no/nordicsemi/android/mesh/opcodes/ConfigMessageOpCodes.java and ProxyConfigMessageOpCodes.java. (4) net:addr:<hex> fixed addresses used by the app (V7/C0851h, MeshAddress.END_GROUP_ADDRESS, literal 65535 in interactors, 0x0000 unpublish); net:range:<unicast|group|scene> from MeshNetworkRepositoryImpl.h3/j3; net:alloc:<element-group|room-group|scene-number|timer-scene> from the repositories that call Nordic createGroup/createScene. (5) net:http:get:<path> and net:http:post-config:<body DTO class lowercase> - every Retrofit method in de/jung/junghome/data/mesh/api/b.java (grep '@o(\|@f('). (6) net:cloud:fn:<callable lowercase> - every string passed to the Firebase callable getter in data/cloud/api/CloudApiImpl.java (grep 'this.f40743a.a("'); net:cloud:firestore:<collection> / net:cloud:storage:junghome-json from string literals in data/cloud/** (accessRequests, members, projects/<id>/JungHome.json). (7) net:export:envelope + net:export:meta.<field lowercase> - every field of domain/dto/ExportDto and MetaData (copy(...) signature). (8) net:db:<table lowercase> - every CREATE TABLE in K7/c.java except SoftwareVersionEntity, StmSoftwareVersionEntity, BlindOperationModeEntity (device-state/firmware caches, other domains). (9) net:pref:<key> - SharedPreferences keys in K7/i.java matching ^(gateway_|display_gateway|use_status_message|local_user_role|last_known_user_role|multi_user_chosen|show_mesh_network_cell). (10) net:enum:<class[.nested] lowercase> - value domains referenced by the items above: p056e8/i (KeyMode), domain/item/{GroupConnection.Function, DeviceConnection.Element, AllowedGroupConnectionFunctions, DeviceSetupProgress, User.Role, ParticipantRequest, ProjectQrCode, icon/GroupIcon, icon/SceneIcon, devices/MiniActuatorDevice.BinaryInputLayout, automatic/AstroTimerMode}, domain/item/mesh/{TimeRole, Timer.Action, JHSchedulerType, JHSchedulerStatus, JHSceneAction, PropertySetMode, RefreshPhase, TransitionTime, DayOfWeek, HvacMode, KeyModeGroupConfig, nodes/models/{LayoutMode, InputEdgeDetection, threshold/ThresholdAction}} and the nested enums/params of the interactors (ConnectToAddress.ConnectionType, GetModelsForDeviceConnection.ModelType, CommunicateWithDevice.CommunicationType, SetRtrPropertyConnection.ConnectionType, KeyRenewal.KeyRenewalPhase, CheckNameInput.CheckType, ImportExportCoordinator.Status). Values read from the simple-mode decompile (enum constructor string literals). (11) net:debug:<viewmodel lowercase>.<method lowercase> - every coroutine class '*ViewModel$<method>$1.java' under de/jung/junghome/app/ui/meshnetwork/** (hidden screen, unlocked by 7 taps on the version) except method names matching ^(observe.*|state|internalStateFlow|networkTitle|primaryAppKey|primaryNetworkKey|special|groups|checkIfRoleConceptActive|checkIfUserGroup|requestCurrentMinVersion|resetMinRequiredVersion|updateMinRequiredVersion|disconnect|requestForSelection)$ and UpdateDebugViewModel (firmware); plus the non-coroutine click cases in meshnetwork/ViewOnClickListenerC1872d.java that act on the network (IV index +1, IV update test mode, reset network, export logs/DB) as net:debug:meshnetworkactivity.<action>. (12) net:ui:<feature> - second sweep: string-resource key prefixes in res/values/strings.xml (awk -F_ '{print $1"_"$2}' | sort | uniq -c) for central_function, connection_*, group_function, key_mode, lock_function, gateway_*, threshold_*, timer_*, scene_scheduling, scheduler_register, share_via, project_share, import_file, participant_request, qr_code, user_mode, no_timekeeper, configuration_time_keeper, mini_actuator, switch_layout, puck_sleep, delete_user, rtr_connection; each prefix was mapped to an existing item, and only UI-level behaviour not owned by a single interactor got a net:ui item (central control sheet, connection categories, room functions per source, temperature connections, gateway key note, scene capacity, scheduler selection, project share/import). Scope decisions: vendor/SIG property ids and application opcodes written by these flows are quoted inside details only (they belong to the prop:/msg: domains); provisioning transport and firmware update are other domains. No mesh heartbeat, friend, node identity or AppKey update feature exists in the app (see unused net:cfg items). (13) second completeness pass (different angle: click handlers, not coroutine classes): every setOnClickListener / setOnCheckedChangeListener in de/jung/junghome/app/ui/meshnetwork/** (and the R8 synthetic dispatchers they instantiate, e.g. I6/b.java 'new I6.b(<case>, ...)', ViewOnClickListenerC1872d, nodeDetails/c, project/c) was walked case by case; a case whose body calls a UseCase directly (grep -nE 'UseCase\.[ef]\(|\.e\(C1539p\.d\(' in those files), a MeshNetwork mutator (grep -rlE '\.(removeScene|removeGroup|removeProvisioner|setIvIndex|addProvisioner)\(' outside no/nordicsemi) or MeshManagerApi, and is not already an item via a *ViewModel$<method>$1 class, became net:debug:<declaring class lowercase (MeshNetworkActivity, NodeDetailsActivity, ProjectDebugFragment)>.<android:id of the view lowercase from res/layout/*.xml>; preference switches (K7/i setters E/O/Q/U) map to net:pref items, bottom-sheet/navigation cases to the screens' own ViewModel items. Cross-checks that found nothing new: Nordic MeshNetwork mutator call sites outside no/nordicsemi (grep '\.<method>(' for every public add*/remove*/set*/update*/create*/distribute*/revoke* of MeshNetwork/BaseMeshNetwork/MeshManagerApi), app/service/* (AppStartService, GatewaySyncService, TimeKeeperService = UI driver of EnsureTimeKeeper, UserModeSyncService, CloudOfflineService, ConnectionViewService), every domain.interactors import in de/jung/junghome/app/** (only config/demo/forceAppUpdate/update and Error classes are unmapped), the 9 Retrofit methods of data/mesh/api/b.java and absolute https literals, and the config traffic in docs/parity/captures-inventory.json (key=dev: only Heartbeat Publication/Subscription Get/Set/Status, all net:cfg items).

items.title: Unassigned address used to remove a publication
items.details: Removing any publication = ConfigModelPublicationSet(element, publishAddress=0x0000, appKeyIndex 0, credential 0, ttl 0xFF, period 0, retransmit 0, model). PublicationCapable.e0() returns 0. Used by RemoveConnectionForAddress (AllConnections/SpecificConnection/SensorConnection), time-keeper removal, sensor-publication off. The app never uses Subscription Delete All/Overwrite.

items.title: Device-type group: all lamps
items.details: 0xFEF5 = END_GROUP_ADDRESS(0xFEFF)-10 = C0851h.f4829a.first (65269). Hidden CDB group named 'device type group #65269'. Subscribed (ConfigModelSubscriptionAdd) by every supported server model of LampDevice, DimLampDevice, SwitchLampDevice, MeasureLampDevice, TunableWhiteLampDevice (x1() override). Central function 'all luminaires': GenericOnOffSetUnacknowledged / LightLightnessSetUnacknowledged -> 0xFEF5.

items.title: Device-type group: all blinds (position element)
items.details: 0xFEF6 = C0892b.f5743r0 (first+1). BlindDevice supported servers on the blind position element (element of the first GenericLevelServer) subscribe. Central 'all blinds': GenericLevelSetUnacknowledged (0 % up / 100 % down / position) and GenericDeltaSet(0) stop -> 0xFEF6.

items.title: Device-type group: all slats
items.details: 0xFEF7 = C0892b.f5744s0 (first+2). BlindDevice supported servers on the slat element (c2() = GenericLevelServer on the last element of the device range) subscribe. Central 'all slats': GenericLevelSetUnacknowledged -> 0xFEF7.

items.title: Device-type group: all sockets
items.details: 0xFEF8 = p0.f6054p (first+3). SocketDevice and subclasses (SwitchSocketDevice, SwitchMeasureSocketDevice) supported servers subscribe. Central 'all sockets': GenericOnOffSetUnacknowledged -> 0xFEF8.

items.title: Device-type group: all room thermostats (RTR)
items.details: 0xFEF9 = RtrDevice.f46242w0 (first+4). RtrDevice supported servers subscribe. Central 'all temperature regulators': GenericLevelSetUnacknowledged -> 0xFEF9 with pct=(t-5)/25*100 (5..30 degC) converted to level=round(-32768+pct/100*65535). 0xFEFA..0xFEFE are inside the reserved range but unused.

items.title: Time-keeper group
items.details: 0xFEFF = MeshAddress.END_GROUP_ADDRESS, CDB group name '#time_keeper_group#' (created by MeshUserGroupRepository.Z0()). Time keeper's 0x1200 Time Server publishes (PUBLISH_ONLY, period 0) to 0xFEFF; every legacy PP2 puck's 0x1200 Time Server gets ConfigModelSubscriptionAdd(0xFEFF).

items.title: All-nodes address used by the app
items.details: 0xFFFF usages: (1) Scene Client 0x1205 of a scene key publishes to 0xFFFF (ConnectToAddress PUBLISH_ONLY, flags 112); (2) scene recall = SceneRecallUnacknowledged(0x8243) -> 0xFFFF; (3) TimeSet (0x5C) unacknowledged broadcast to 0xFFFF at every app start; (4) 0xFFFF is always added to the proxy filter (white list during setup, black list afterwards).

items.title: Element connection group allocation (one group per element)
items.details: MeshElementConnectionGroupRepository.n1(elementAddress): returns cached ElementConnectionGroupEntity(elementAddress,address) or Nordic createGroup(selectedProvisioner, 'element group #'+<decimal element address>, firstGroupRange, forbidden) + addGroup + Room insert. Address = lowest free in the provisioner's first group range not in CDB groups and not in the forbidden list (all GroupEntity addresses U all ElementConnectionGroupEntity addresses) -> rooms and element groups share one sequential counter from 0xC000. Hidden from the room list (name prefix 'element group #').

items.title: Room (area / user group) address allocation and default rooms
items.details: MeshUserGroupRepository.R0(): Nordic createGroup(provisioner, name, firstRange, forbidden) -> next free >= 0xC000 (shared counter with element groups); meshNetwork.addGroup; Room GroupEntity(name,address,isFavorite,icon). 5 default rooms from res/values/arrays.xml 'group_defaults' (Living room, Kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, children's room) created when no non-element, non-device-type group exists (DI list 'DefaultGroups').

items.title: Scene number allocation
items.details: MeshNetwork.createScene(provisioner,name) = lowest free number in the provisioner's allocated scene range (1,2,3,...), then addScene + Scene.setName; Room SceneEntity(name,isFavorite,sceneNumber,icon). Timer scenes use the same allocator (see net:alloc:timer-scene).

items.title: Timer scene allocation ('TimerScene <index> <deviceId>')
items.details: For SIG-scheduler timers on dim/TW/blind/RTR devices a CDB scene named 'TimerScene <schedulerIndex> <deviceId>' is created (MeshSceneRepository.M1) and the device's current state stored in it (StoreDeviceConfigurationInScene); the SchedulerActionSet then uses action SceneRecall(2) + that number. Consumes the device's 16-entry scene register.

items.title: Config AppKey Add (0x00)
items.details: AddAppKeyMessageBuilder: ConfigAppKeyAdd(networkKey index 0, applicationKey index 0) to node primary unicast, DevKey. Sent in ConfigureDevice step SetWhitelistFilter and again in SetConfiguration; also in UpdateDeviceSettingsForForcedUpdate. Only AppKey 0 is ever used.

items.title: Config AppKey Update - not used by the app
items.details: Class exists in the bundled Nordic library (ConfigAppKeyUpdate) but no class outside no/nordicsemi references it (grep -rlw ConfigAppKeyUpdate). The app therefore has no feature for it (e.g. no mesh heartbeat configuration, no friend/node-identity control, no unbind, no virtual addresses, no NetKey add/delete, no subscription overwrite/delete-all).

items.title: Config Model Publication Set (0x03)

Every production caller passes ConnectToAddress flags 112 -> period steps 0 / resolution 0 (defaults 30/1 masked). Removal sends publishAddress 0x0000. items.details: Unlock of the hidden mesh-network debug screen (7 taps on version).

items.details: Default false; only toggled in the hidden mesh screen; selects reduced element-group wiring in CreateElementConnectionGroups.

items.title: Proxy Config Set Filter Type (0x00)
items.details: ProxyConfigSetFilterType(WHITE_LIST=0 / BLACK_LIST=1) to 0x0000. BLACK_LIST before each ConfigureDevice (SetProxySettings), WHITE_LIST in step SetWhitelistFilter, BLACK_LIST in step SetBlacklistFilter and on every normal proxy connection (empty black list = receive everything).

items.title: Proxy Config Add Addresses To Filter (0x01)
items.details: AddProxyFilterAddressesMessageBuilder: during setup {node unicast, 0xFFFF, provisioner unicast} (white list), afterwards {node unicast, 0xFFFF} (black list). Quirk: each address is cast to a byte and added twice, so only 0xFFFF survives intact.

items.title: Proxy Config Remove Addresses From Filter (0x02) - not used by the app
items.details: Present in the Nordic library, never referenced by app code; filters are only reset via Set Filter Type.

items.title: Provisioner group-address range
items.details: Group range size = min((0xFEF4-0xC000)/10, free) = 1611 -> first provisioner [0xC000,0xC64B] (nextAvailableGroupAddressRange). Every provisioner additionally gets the fixed range [0xFEF5,0xFEFF] (device-type + time-keeper groups) unless another provisioner already owns it; repaired in T1() if missing.

items.title: Provisioner scene-number range
items.details: Scene range size = min((65535-1)/10, free) = 6553 -> first provisioner [1, 6554] (nextAvailableSceneAddressRange).

items.title: Provisioner unicast range and own address
items.details: Unicast range size = min((0x7FFF-1)/10, free) = 3276 -> first provisioner [0x0001,0x0CCD]. Provisioner's own unicast is random inside its range avoiding networkExclusions and nodes (g3()). Max 10 provisioners (one per user/phone). Node addresses: nextAvailableUnicastAddress(nodes.size(), provisioner), +1 retry on collision.

items.title: Offline handling of admin mode
items.details: When role concept enabled (remote config role_concept_enabled) and cloud offline: OfflineDialogType CloudOffline / CloudOfflineTemporarySwitchToMember / NoAction.

items.title: Device setup progress holder
items.details: StateFlow<DeviceSetupProgress> shared by provisioning/configuration; Finished/ProvisioningFinished/ProvisioningNotStarted gate EnsureTimeKeeper and other background work.

items.title: Ensure a time keeper exists while legacy pucks exist
items.details: Runs when setup is Finished/NotStarted, no BLE process runs and user is owner: if PP2 pucks (PID 0x0010..0x0014, DeviceFilter.MiniActuatorPP) exist and no keeper is configured, pick one (TimeKeeperPrioritizedDevices) via TimeKeeperConfiguration (setNewTimeKeeper, connectPP2DevicesToTimeKeeper, runCatchingWithRetry). Emits TimeKeeperEvent NoAdditionalConfigurationNeeded / TimeKeeperFound / TimeKeeperCouldNotBeEnsured(isOwner) / TimeKeeperError(isLastChunk); UI dialogs no_timekeeper_*.

items.title: Import when a newer cloud file appears
items.details: Service: on new sync metadata -> ImportProjectFromCloudStorage(Import).

items.title: No-provisioner error channel
items.details: Emits when PrepareMeshNetwork(SelectUserProvisioner) finds no provisioner for this user (user removed from project) -> UI 'project removed'.

items.title: Time keeper configuration service
items.details: Functions configureAsTimeKeeper / connectPP2DevicesToTimeKeeper / removeAllTimeKeepers / getConfiguredTimeKeeper / findTimeKeeperCompatibleDevice / requestTimeRoleAndUpdateReachability. Keeper: ConnectToAddress(keeper, [0x1200 TimeServer], 0xFEFF, PUBLISH_ONLY) (ConfigModelPublicationSet period 0) + UpdateTimeRole(MeshTimeRelay 2) on the 0x1201 Time Setup Server. PP2 pucks: ConfigModelSubscriptionAdd(0x1200 -> 0xFEFF). Removal: TimeRole MeshTimeClient 3 + publication 0x0000 (RemoveConnectionForAddress.SpecificConnection). Priority for keeper: MiniActuatorHardwired, SwitchMeasureSocket, SwitchSocket, MotionDetector, PresenceDetector, TwoGangRocker, OneGangRocker, Rtr (never gateway or battery devices).

items.title: Effective user role
items.details: Combines projectUserRole (cloud) and localUserRole; members get a reduced UI, cannot export or run DeleteUnusedScenes.

items.title: Accept participant (owner creates provisioner)
items.details: Params(request, userName): must be online; createNewProvisioner named after the participant (max 10 provisioners -> MaxProjectMembers), ExportProjectToCloudStorage + waitForProjectToBeSynced, callable acceptAccessRequest {projectId, requestId, provisionerId}; on failure cleanUpProvisioner. Errors Offline/ProvisionerCreation/SyncProject/AcceptRequest/CleanUpProvisioner.

items.title: Accept third-party API client
items.details: Params(permissionName): POST config {"data":{"api_client_accept": "<name>"}}; open requests expire after 3 min on the gateway.

items.title: Recall scene
items.details: Params(sceneNumber): SceneRecallUnacknowledged (0x8243) [scene u16 LE][tid] -> 0xFFFF, no transition/delay.

items.title: Add/re-store devices in a scene
items.details: Params(sceneNumber, devices: CreateSceneItem list, shouldBeSynced=true) -> StoreDeviceConfigurationInScene for all items (edit re-stores every remaining member).

items.title: Add a device to rooms (multi-select)
items.details: Params(deviceId, groups): for each group not yet containing the device -> AddGroupToDevices(groupAddress, [device]). Error 'Device is already part of the group'.

items.title: Room membership (subscribe members) + rewire room-linked keys
items.details: Params(groupAddress, devices). addDevicesToGroup: per new member models=[0x1000,0x1002] on the device's first element (or server models of an existing KeyModeGroupConfig function) not yet subscribed -> ConnectToAddress(device, models, room.address, SUBSCRIBE_ONLY). reconnectSwitchesWithGroup: for every KeyModeGroupConfig of every button linked to this room -> SetGroupFunction re-run so the new load also subscribes to the button's element group.

items.title: Is a gateway in the project
items.details: true if any device is a gateway (PID 0x000B). Gates gateway UI and export.

items.title: Sensor-values info page viewed flag
items.details: Pref gateway_sensor_values_viewed; bubble indicator only.

items.title: Verify expected logical devices per node
items.details: Params(devices): expects 2 logical devices for Blind/Dimming/Switch/TwDimming, 3 for TwoGang*; single-device products {0x0003,0x0005,0x0006,0x000A,0x000B,0x000C,0x0015,0x0016} or function Extension. Errors MissingDevicesException, MultipleDevicesExpectedException, NotExpectedDeviceCountException, ActuatorFunctionNotFoundException. No mesh message.

items.title: Project validity gate
items.details: true when a mesh network/project exists; gates LoadInitialDeviceState.

items.title: Wi-Fi gate for gateway upload
items.details: Project file upload to the gateway only on Wi-Fi (gateway_automatic_share_project_no_wifi_dialog).

items.title: Name validation for devices/rooms/scenes
items.details: Params(name, checkType DEVICE|GROUP|SCENE): errors Blank, AlreadyTaken (case-insensitive), NotAllowed (name is not a valid format string, i.e. String.format(name) throws - e.g. stray '%').

items.title: Detect stale gateway project file
items.details: Compares CreateProjectFile meta.hashCode() with pref gateway_network_hash and gateway_upload_failed -> 'Project file out of date' indicator.

items.title: Read back sensor publication state
items.details: Params Device(deviceId) / Debug(all IoT devices): ConfigModelPublicationGet(sensorElement, 0x1100) per Sensor Server; result: publish address != 0 -> 'sensor values for gateway' enabled.

items.title: Check timers of a node
items.details: Params(nodeId): runs GetAllTimer for the node's devices and returns the Timer list; used only by the hidden node-details debug screen (NodeDetailsViewModel).

items.title: Clear gateway sync error
items.details: Resets the gateway sync error state (gateway_upload_failed).

items.title: Send one capability request/update to a device
items.details: Params(deviceId, capability, communicationType REQUEST|UPDATE|UNKNOWN, waitForStatus). REQUEST -> builder b() (Get), UPDATE -> builder c() (Set). Destination: config msgs -> node primary unicast (DevKey); proxy config -> 0x0000; app msgs -> capability.O() address. Acked: 3 attempts x 3000 ms waiting for status from the same element (vendor: also D1 27 05). MaxRequestTimeout -> failedMessagesCounter=3 (unreachable). Auto-binds destination element models first. Every network-configuration flow in this inventory goes through it.

items.title: Factory key wiring after provisioning
items.details: Params(deviceUUid): for each initial publication from GetInitialControlSwitchPublication -> SetDeviceConnection.AddressParams (client models publish+subscribe to the target load's element group, KeyMode written). Error CouldNotSetConnectionToAddress.

items.title: Change button layout / operating concept (incl. mini-actuator 'connect inputs')
items.details: Params(deviceId, layoutMode, step, deviceAddress). Steps UpdateButtonLayout -> Reprovisioning -> Finished: LBC Admin Set 0x5001 ButtonLayout = u16 LE LayoutMode (unacknowledged), then ReprovisioningDevice (element layout of the node changes; all key settings reset). Mini actuator: connected inputs -> ONE_ROCKER(1), separate inputs -> ONE_TOP_ONE_BOTTOM(0) (restart dialog). Errors ButtonLayoutUpdateFailed / ReprovisioningFailed.

items.title: Detector defaults after provisioning
items.details: Params(deviceId) for motion/presence detectors: for the detector's factory publication (last-element 0x1001 client -> element of the node's first OnOff server) SetDeviceConnection.AddressParams (client publishes to that load element group, KeyMode written); Admin Set 0x6021 DetectorRepetitionTime = 50 (RepetitionTimeCapability); Admin Set 0x100B ManualOffEnable = true for every ManualOffEnable-capable device of the node; Admin Set 0x1007 TimedOnDuration = 120000 ms (max 14400000) for every lamp device of the node. Error CouldNotSetConnection.

items.title: Post-provisioning configuration step machine
items.details: Params(identifier, macAddress, requestButtonLayout). Pre: SetProxySettings (ProxyConfigSetFilterType BLACK_LIST). Steps (DeviceSetupProgress): 1 SetWhitelistFilter: ConfigAppKeyAdd(net 0, app 0); ProxySetFilterType WHITE_LIST; ProxyAddAddresses{node, 0xFFFF, provisioner}. 2 RequestCompositionData: ConfigCompositionDataGet(0); ConfigModelAppBind for bind-list models. 3 SetConfiguration: ConfigGattProxySet(1); ConfigAppKeyAdd; ConfigDefaultTtlSet(5); ConfigRelaySet(1, count 3, 90 ms/steps 9); ConfigNetworkTransmitSet(count 3, 100 ms/steps 10). 4 SetBlacklistFilter: ProxySetFilterType BLACK_LIST + ProxyAddAddresses{node, 0xFFFF}; ConfigBeaconSet(!lowPower) unack. 5 RequestRequiredData: assert 0x1012 & 0x0527:1012 present; LBC User Property Get 0x0002 InsertId (CE 27 05) -> ActuatorFunctionId/InsertType; if requestButtonLayout Admin Get 0x5001. 6 SetTime: TimeSet (0x5C) unicast to the first Time-Server element with phone TAI time (errors ignored). 7 CreateElementGroups (30 s). 8 FinishConfiguration: per device UpdateDeviceAddress + ConnectToDeviceTypeGroup; ConfigureDetector; ConfigureGateway; ConfigureSocket; RTR -> LBC Manufacturer Get 0x0005; RequestManufacturerInfos; battery -> Generic Battery Get 0x8223; CheckForMissingDevices; PP2 puck -> create 0xFEFF group + Time Server subscription. 9 DisableProxy (low power: ConfigGattProxySet 0). 10 ReconnectToDevice -> Finished. Retry twice; final failure -> ResetDevice(id,false).

items.title: Read gateway credentials over mesh
items.details: Params(deviceId) for PID 0x000B: LBC Manufacturer Property Get (C8 27 05) of 0xC001 GatewayAPIToken, 0xC002 GatewayIP, 0xC003 GatewayFingerprint (ASCII), 3 s timeout each; values feed the REST client (https://<ip>/api/junghome/..., header Token, TLS pinned to SHA-256 fingerprint); then PollGatewayConfig. Run at end of setup, app start and on HTTP 401/404/503. Error CouldNotReceiveData.

items.title: Mini-actuator binary input connection dispatcher
items.details: Params DeviceParams(deviceId, inputNumber FIRST|SECOND|BOTH, connectToDevice, element, keyMode, notePosition) -> SetDeviceConnection.DeviceParams; GroupParams(deviceId, inputNumber, selectedGroup, selectedFunction) -> SetGroupConnection.KeyModeParams; SceneParams(deviceId, inputNumber, selectedScene) -> SetSceneConnection. Category -> key mode: Switching Switch 5, Light Light 0, Hangings Move 1, Temperature RTR 4, Gateway 6. Steps SetConnection -> Finished(newDeviceId).

items.title: Sensor values for IoT systems (gateway) switch
items.details: Params(establishConnection, deviceId?). On: for every 0x1100 Sensor Server of the device (or of all IoT devices from the debug switch) ConnectToAddress(PUBLISH_ONLY, elementGroupOf(sensorElement)) = ConfigModelPublicationSet(period 0) to the sensor element's own element group; firmware >= 1.3.0.0 gate. Off: RemoveConnectionForAddress.SensorConnection -> publication 0x0000. Then RequestManufacturerInfos. The gateway listens on that group.

items.title: Wire LBC user-property servers for property-mode keys
items.details: (simple-mode) Params(devices, rocker): for each device (filtered to sockets / mini actuators) every 0x0527:1013 LBCGenericUserPropertyServer -> ConnectToAddress(PUBLISH_ONLY, own element group); each client model of the rocker -> ConnectToAddress(SUBSCRIBE_ONLY, same group). Called at the end of SetDeviceConnection.DeviceParams with a rocker.

items.title: Measuring socket initial reads
items.details: Params(deviceId) for PID 0x0003: unacknowledged SIG Generic Admin Property Get (0x822D) 0x006D TotalDevicePowerOnTime and 0x006A TotalDeviceEnergyUse, SensorGet 0x0081 ActivePower, LBC User Property Get 0x5010/0x5011 energy charts.

items.title: Connect/disconnect gateway cloud
items.details: Params(setConnectionTo): POST config {"data":{"cloud_connect": bool}}.

items.title: Generic pub/sub primitive (ConnectToAddress)
items.details: Params(deviceId, models, address, type in {PUBLISH_AND_SUBSCRIBE, PUBLISH_ONLY, SUBSCRIBE_ONLY}, publicationSteps default 30, publicationStepsResolution default 1, waitForStatus). All callers pass flags 112 -> steps 0 / resolution 0. For each (elementAddress, modelId): if type != SUBSCRIBE_ONLY -> PublicationCapability -> ConfigModelPublicationSet(element, address, appKeyIdx 0, cred 0, ttl 0xFF, period 0, retransmit 0/0, model); if type != PUBLISH_ONLY -> SubscriptionCapability -> ConfigModelSubscriptionAdd(element, address, model). Each via CommunicateWithDevice(UPDATE, waitForStatus=true) with DevKey to the node primary; failure -> FailedToConnect.

items.title: Subscribe a device to its device-type group(s)
items.details: Params(deviceId): addresses = device.x1() (default empty; lamps 0xFEF5, blinds 0xFEF6 position element + 0xFEF7 slat element, sockets 0xFEF8, RTR 0xFEF9; control switches, detectors, mini-actuator inputs, gateway none). models = supported servers of the node's elements (blind: per element) -> ConnectToAddress(SUBSCRIBE_ONLY) = ConfigModelSubscriptionAdd per model.

items.title: Connect to a mesh proxy of the network
items.details: Scans for 0x1828 advertisements whose Network ID belongs to the network ('Device belongs to the network. Trying to connect'), retries on scan error, connects and applies SetProxySettings (empty black list). Waits for cloud import status.

items.title: Create astro (sunrise/sunset) SIG timer
items.details: Params(identifier, action, dayOfWeek, astroTimer, locationPoint, timerInDevice): Generic Location Global Set Unacknowledged if the device has a Location Setup Server; CreateTimer with hh:mm = 'no later than' (23:59 if unset); LBC Admin Set property 7 AstroSchedulerRegister 40 bits: registerId(4) mode(4: 0 static, 1 sunrise, 2 sunset) offsetMin(int8) earliestHH(5) earliestMM(6) latestHH(5) latestMM(6). Error DeviceDoesNotSupportAstroTimer.

items.title: Create element connection groups for a device
items.details: (simple-mode) supported servers = DI list 'suppportedServers' [0x1000,0x1002,0x1300,0x1306,0x1303,0x0527:1013,0x1100,0x1203,0x0527:1011]. For every element of the node hosting >=1 of them: n1(element) allocates/looks up its element group. Default (pref use_status_message_optimization=false): all supported servers of that element except 0x1100 Sensor Server -> ConnectToAddress(PUBLISH_AND_SUBSCRIBE, elementGroup). Optimisation flag on: per device type only the primary server (TW->first LightCtlServer, Dim->LightLightnessServer, Blind->GenericLevelServer, Rtr->GenericLevelServer+GenericOnOffServer, else GenericOnOffServer) + LBCGenericUserPropertyServer on button elements (location 64..67) + SceneServer PUBLISH_AND_SUBSCRIBE, and for TW lamps the colour-temperature GenericLevelServer SUBSCRIBE_ONLY. Runs in ConfigureDevice step CreateElementGroups (30 s budget).

items.title: Create room/area
items.details: Params(name, icon, isFavorite): CheckNameInput(GROUP) (non-blank, case-insensitive unique) -> MeshUserGroupRepository.R0: allocate next free group address (net:alloc:room-group), meshNetwork.addGroup, Room GroupEntity. No mesh message.

items.title: Create/update JH vendor schedule (automation)
items.details: Params Create(deviceIdentifier, notBeforeHour, notBeforeMinute, dayOfWeek set, action, astroTimer?, locationPoint) / Update(schedulerIndex, ...). Slot = first JHSchedulerStatus Available index 0..15 (NoIndexAvailable). Astro: Generic Location Global Set Unacknowledged (0x42) lat/lon int32 = floor(deg/90|180*(2^31-1)), alt int16 to the device's Location Setup Server (phone GPS, fallback 52.516811/13.408333). JH Scheduler Set (D4 27 05) sub-command Schedule 0: type TimedActive 3 / SunriseActive 5 / SunsetActive 7, weekday mask (Mon=1..Sun=64), notBefore hh:mm, notAfter hh:mm (31 = unset), offset int8 min; then Set sub-command Action 1: action code + 40-bit payload (Switching / Lightness / LightnessAndColorTemperature K / BlindsAndSlatsPosition / TargetTemperature degC x100). centralScheduleId never set. Error DeviceDoesNotSupportJHScheduler.

items.title: Build ExportDto (project file)
items.details: ExportDto{version "1.1", appVersion "2.2.0 (822956)", platform "Android (<sdk>)", meta (MetaData from all Exportable repositories), network = Base64 NO_WRAP of the Nordic CDB JSON}. 'Could not export parts of the network.' on partial failure.

items.title: Create project-sharing QR code
items.details: QR = Base64 of JSON ProjectQrCode {"id": <projectId>, "key": <Base64 AES key>}. Error NoValidKey. Up to 10 devices/users.

items.title: Create scene (name/icon validation)
items.details: Params(sceneName, sceneIcon): non-empty name ('scene name must not be empty') -> MeshSceneRepository create: Nordic createScene (lowest free number) + addScene + setName, Room SceneEntity(icon = SceneIcon class name, 30 values). No mesh message until devices are stored.

items.title: Enable project synchronization (owner)
items.details: Callable createNewProject {info:{name, deviceManufacturer, deviceModel, provisionerId}} -> ProjectResponseDto{id}; ProjectEntity(shouldBeSynced); initial ExportProjectToCloudStorage(isInitialSync=true).

items.title: Create ON/OFF power threshold automation (measuring socket)
items.details: (simple-mode) Params(deviceId, thresholdCapable, publication, threshold, devices). Admin Set 0x5004 TurnOnThreshold or 0x5005 TurnOffThreshold, 8 bytes [u16 LE 0x0081 ActivePowerLoadSide][u16 LE seconds][u24 LE power x0.1 W, 0xFFFFFF unset][u8 active]; wiring: socket meter element 0x1001 OnOff Client ConnectToAddress(PUBLISH_AND_SUBSCRIBE, own element group); removed targets RemoveConnectionForAddress.GroupConnection; each target load's 0x1000 server ConnectToAddress(SUBSCRIBE_ONLY, that group). One ON and one OFF threshold per socket.

items.title: Create SIG scheduler timer
items.details: Params(identifier, hour, minute, dayOfWeek, action, timerInDevice). Index = GetNextAvailableTimerIndex. On/off devices: SchedulerActionSet (0x60, acked) entry index(4) year(7)=100 Any, month(12)=all, day(5)=0 Any, hour(5), minute(6), second(6)=0, dayOfWeek(7), action(4) TurnOff 0/TurnOn 1, transition(8), scene(16)=0. Dim/TW/blind/RTR: create timer scene + StoreDeviceConfigurationInScene, action SceneRecall 2 + scene number. Then SchedulerGet (0x8249), SchedulerMetaInfoEntity(index, deviceId, action, scene), SaveTimerBackwardsCompatible. Errors DeviceDoesNotSupportTimer, NoSceneCapacityAvailable.

items.title: Remove a device from rooms
items.details: Params(deviceId, groups): for each group -> DeleteGroupFromDevices(groupAddress, [device]).

items.title: Remove one device from several scenes
items.details: Params(deviceId, sceneNumbers) -> RemoveDeviceConfigurationFromScene per scene (SceneCompatible devices only).

items.title: Remove several devices from a scene
items.details: Params(sceneNumber, devices) -> DeleteDeviceFromScenes per device. Error FailedToDeleteSceneFromDevices.

items.title: Delete room
items.details: Params(groupAddress): DeleteGroupFromDevices(address, all members) (ConfigModelSubscriptionDelete); every device holding a KeyModeGroupConfig for this room -> RemoveConnectionForAddress.GroupConnection (room-linked keys lose publication/subscriptions); meshNetwork.removeGroup + Room delete.

items.title: Remove members from a room
items.details: Params(groupAddress, devices): RemoveConnectionForAddress.GroupConnection(device, room.address, firstElement, ...) = ConfigModelSubscriptionDelete of the room address (and the loads' subscriptions to room-linked buttons' element groups; KeyModeGroupConfig of those buttons dropped). Error FailedToRemoveDeviceFromGroup / 'Couldn't clear all subscriptions!'.

items.title: Delete JH schedule
items.details: Params(deviceId, schedulerIndex): type-only Set with type Available 0.

items.title: Withdraw/delete participant request
items.details: Params(request): delete Firestore document accessRequests/<id> ('Request not found').

items.title: Delete scene
items.details: Params(sceneNumber, forceDelete): for every non-attachment device of nodes in Scene.addresses -> DeleteDeviceFromScenes; then Nordic removeScene(scene, force) + Room delete. Error FailedToDeleteScene; UI 'Delete anyway' = force.

items.title: Delete threshold
items.details: (simple-mode) Params(deviceId, action ON|OFF): per target load RemoveConnectionForAddress.GroupConnection(load, socketElementGroup); Admin Set 0x5004/0x5005 = value 0xFFFFFF, time 0, active 0.

items.title: Delete SIG timer
items.details: Params(timer, device, capable, register): DeleteScene(timer scene) if Specific; Admin Set 7 static default; SchedulerActionSet all-zero entry (year 0, months 0, action 15, scene 0); SchedulerGet; delete meta rows.

items.title: Delete orphan scenes from a device register
items.details: Params(deviceId): SceneRegisterGet (0x8244) on the device; every stored scene number that is neither an app scene nor used by a Timer -> SceneDelete (0x829E). Triggered when the SIG timer list opens (owner role).

items.title: Deny participant request
items.details: Params(requestId): Firestore accessRequests/<id>.status = "DECLINED".

items.title: Provision before forced update to stop advertising timeout
items.details: Params(uuid, unprovisionedDevice): DeviceProvisioning then UpdateDeviceSettingsForForcedUpdate so an unprovisioned device can be updated.

items.title: Detector presence test off
items.details: Params(deviceId): Admin Set 0x6001/0x6003 back to off.

items.title: Disable GATT proxy on low-power devices
items.details: Params(id, condition): ConfigGattProxySet(0) when device.Q1() (battery wall transmitters, battery puck). Error 'Could not disable proxy'.

items.title: Disable project synchronization
items.details: Turns cloud synchronization off on this phone (four repository calls clearing sync/project/user state, then stops cloud listeners); also reachable from the hidden project debug sheet (ProjectDebugViewModel.disableSync). No mesh traffic.

items.title: Detector presence (walk) test on
items.details: Params(deviceId): LBC Admin Set 0x6001 PresenceTest + 0x6003 PresenceControl (u8) via PresenceTestCapability; while active poll Manufacturer Get 0x6005 every 1 s; auto DisablePresenceTest after 300 s.

items.title: Export project file locally
items.details: CreateProjectFile under ImportExportCoordinator export lock -> pretty JSON <filesDir>/JungHome.json; shared via ACTION_SEND ('Share project file' / Project handover).

items.title: Upload encrypted project to cloud
items.details: Params(isInitialSync): if IsExportAllowed: CreateProjectFile -> compact JSON -> AES-256-GCM (IV 12 bytes || ciphertext+tag) with the project key -> Firebase Storage projects/<projectId>/JungHome.json (content-type application/json, metadata uploadedBy=<uid>).

items.title: Upload project file to the JUNG HOME gateway
items.details: If a gateway is in the project, no BLE process runs and Wi-Fi is on: POST https://<0xC002>/api/junghome/config {"data":{"project_file": <ExportDto>}} (Token header, pinned TLS), 2 retries 15 s apart; on success store gateway_network_hash = meta.hashCode() and gateway_last_sync, else gateway_upload_failed=true ('Project file out of date' / 'Gateway synchronisation pending').

items.title: Read SIG timers of a device
items.details: Params(device, requestAstroTimer): SchedulerGet (0x8249) -> 16-bit register; SchedulerActionGet (0x8248) per index; Admin Get 8 AstroSchedulerStatus and Admin Get 7 [+index byte] per astro register.

items.title: Loads driven by an RTR
items.details: Params(deviceIdentifier=RTR): devices (ConnectToRTRDevices filter) whose GenericOnOffServer subscribes to the RTR client's publish address (element group). Derived from CDB only.

items.title: Classify an existing key/input connection (read back)
items.details: Params(publicationCapable). From CDB publish address P: cached KeyModeSceneConfig.sceneId != 0 -> SceneConnection; P is an element group -> owning element's device; if it is the key itself and a KeyModeGroupConfig with publishAddress==P exists -> GroupConnection(room, function); else DeviceConnection(target, P, targetElement, buttonElement) (gateway included), or lock-function connection when KeySetPropertyMode is set. No mesh traffic.

items.title: Devices of a scene (with values)
items.details: Params(sceneNumber, shouldRequestValues): devices from Scene.addresses; optionally request scene values and apply via UpdateDeviceWithSceneInfo.

items.title: GET gateway config
items.details: Params(deviceId must be a gateway): GET /api/junghome/config -> GatewayConfigDTO.

items.title: GET gateway error log
items.details: GET /api/junghome/healthstatus -> [{level,time,description,details}]; DEBUG entries hidden unless pref display_gateway_debug_log.

items.title: Factory (as-shipped) key publications
items.details: Params(deviceIdentifier): PublicationCompatible.O0() publications of the node's keys, skipping blind publications that target a blind whose position element equals the publish target when the blind is not b2(); fed to ConfigureControlSwitchFunctionality.

items.title: Client/server model sets per key mode
items.details: Params(elementAddress, keyMode, modelType CLIENTS|SERVER); only models present on the element. CLIENTS: Light 0 -> 0x1001,0x1003,0x0527:1015; Move 1 -> 0x1003,0x0527:1015; Scene 2 -> 0x1205; Property 3 -> 0x0527:1015; RTR 4 -> 0x1003; Switch 5 -> 0x1001,0x0527:1015; Gateway 6 -> 0x0527:1015; Unset -> none. SERVER: Light -> 0x1000,0x1002; Move -> 0x1002; Scene -> 0x1203; Property -> 0x0527:1013; RTR -> 0x1002; Switch -> 0x1000; Gateway -> 0x0527:1013.

items.title: Pick free scheduler index
items.details: Params(device): first index 0..15 whose entry is all-zero / not in register. Errors IndicesNotAvailable, NoIndexAvailable ('16 automations' dialog scheduler_register_no_capacity_*).

items.title: Which scenes contain a device
items.details: Params(deviceIdentifier, requestSceneIds): legacy = CDB Scene.addresses; vendor multi-channel = SceneActionSetupGet(scene 0 = list) on the channel element and intersect with app scenes.

items.title: Import project file (full replace)
items.details: Params(exportDto) FromFile / FromCloudStorage: under import lock RemoveLocalData (clears all Room tables), importMeshNetworkJson(Base64-decoded 'network'), restore meta tables, PrepareMeshNetwork(ResetProvisioners / SelectUserProvisioner), seq = max(stored, imported). No validation of version/platform/mesh UUID; nothing sent on the mesh. File import requires .json extension.

items.title: Download and import cloud project
items.details: Params Import / InitialImport / ForceImport: download projects/<id>/JungHome.json, skip if uploadedBy == current user (except Force/Initial), decrypt, ImportProject.FromCloudStorage; status via CloudImportStatusChannel. Last writer wins, no merge.

items.title: Participant: import synced project after acceptance
items.details: ImportProjectFromCloudStorage(InitialImport), fetch users, enable sync, start PollGatewayConfig. Errors ImportProjectException / FetchUsersException / EnableSyncException.

items.title: Is a load still driven by another RTR
items.details: Params(deviceId, excludedRtrDeviceIdentifier): true if any other RTR's publication group is in the load's GenericOnOffServer subscription list; gates resetting RtrOperationMode 0x1014.

items.title: BLE process gate
items.details: Flow true while provisioning/configuration/update runs; gates keep-alive, export to gateway, time keeper, invalid-device cleanup.

items.title: Gate for cloud export
items.details: Params(isInitialSync): project must be synced, first cloud import done (CloudImportStatus PROJECT_IMPORTED) and no BLE process running.

items.title: Keep battery transmitters awake during configuration
items.details: Params(deviceId): every 6 s while no BLE process runs, acknowledged LBC Admin Get 0x5001 ButtonLayout to the low-power device; retry after 1 s; emits SleepMode DeviceAwake / DeviceNotAwake / DeviceNotAvailable (puck_sleep_mode_* dialogs).

items.title: Network key refresh (hidden debug screen)
items.details: Params CheckRenewalPhase / CheckRenewalOrStartRenewal. Phases StartKeyRenewal -> KeyDistribution(newKey): ConfigNetKeyUpdate(0x8045) to every node incl. gateway -> UsingNewKeys: ConfigKeyRefreshPhaseSet(2) to all, local switch -> RevokeOldKey: ConfigKeyRefreshPhaseSet(3) -> NormalOperation; then ExportProjectToCloudStorage. NetKey only (no AppKey update), manual only.

items.title: App-start sequence (time broadcast, gateway creds, favourite states)
items.details: After project valid (CheckForValidProject), import/export idle and proxy connected: TimeSet (0x5C) unacknowledged -> 0xFFFF with phone TAI time (TAI epoch 2000-01-01, TAI-UTC 37 s, subsecond millis/256, zone offset minutes/15, uncertainty 0, authority false); LBC Manufacturer Get 0xC001/0xC002/0xC003 to every gateway; LoadStateForDevices(favourites).

items.title: Poll device states in chunks
items.details: Params(devices): reachable devices in chunks of 5, 3 retries, 300 ms between chunks: GenericOnOffGet (0x8201) to OnOff element, GenericLevelGet (0x8205) for blinds, SensorGet 0x004F for RTR (all acked). Steps LoadCurrentState / Finished.

items.title: Firebase login
items.details: Signs in to Firebase (needed for cloud sync). Error LoginError.

items.title: Register gateway in My JUNG Cloud
items.details: Params(userName, userPassword, deviceId): POST config {"data":{"cloud_username","cloud_password","cloud_register":true}}.

items.title: Unregister gateway from My JUNG Cloud
items.details: POST config {"data":{"cloud_register":false}}.

items.title: Derive mini-actuator input assignment
items.details: Params(deviceIdentifier): per input (BinaryInputNumber FIRST/SECOND or BOTH when BinaryInputLayout CONNECTED_INPUTS) -> BinaryInputAssignment(inputNumber, keyMode, connection via GetConnection, inputEdgeDetection 0x5009). Read-only.

items.title: Observe cloud project document
items.details: Firestore listener on the project; 'We are not part of the current project.' -> removal; triggers ImportProjectWhenNewSyncIsAvailable.

items.title: Observe cloud errors
items.details: cloudError / storageError flows -> CloudError InvalidRequest|MaxProjectMembers|PermissionDenied|Unknown. Read-only.

items.title: Observe cloud online status
items.details: Read-only.

items.title: Derive per-key assignment of a push-button
items.details: Params(deviceIdentifier): from ButtonLayout (LayoutMode, 'Unknown Button Layout' otherwise) enumerate ControlSwitchKeyPosition(s) and run GetConnection per rocker -> ControlSwitchKeyAssignment(keyPosition, connection). Read-only.

items.title: Observe gateway config
items.details: Read-only flow of GatewayConfigDTO-derived status (Network / Bluetooth Mesh / Cloud indicators, api_clients, api_client_name_asking).

items.title: Observe gateway HTTP errors
items.details: Read-only. Transport failures are mapped to synthetic HTTP 404 by the interceptor (p212t7/a).

items.title: Pending gateway API permission count
items.details: Size of GatewayConfigDTO.api_client_name_asking (0 on HTTP error).

items.title: Observe gateway sync errors
items.details: Read-only.

items.title: Observe one room
items.details: Params(groupAddress): Room + CDB; membership derived from CDB subscriptions of members' first element. Read-only.

items.title: Observe rooms
items.details: Params(filter GroupFilter All|Device|GroupList|IsFavorite|UpdateNavigation); hides element groups ('element group #') and device-type addresses; favourites first, then non-empty. Read-only.

items.title: Observe JH schedules (list shown to user)
items.details: Params(deviceId): builds JHSchedule(schedulerIndex, daysOfWeek, localTime, offsetMin, effectiveTime, action); slots with status Available 0 or CentralScheduleIdMatched 1 are hidden (central-owned slots read-only).

items.title: Observe mesh network object
items.details: Read-only flow of the Nordic MeshNetwork (V7.p).

items.title: Observe incoming mesh status notifications
items.details: Read-only flow of (MeshStatusNotification, device) pairs from MeshNotificationChannel.

items.title: Observe own participant request
items.details: Firestore accessRequests where userId == me; status PENDING/ACCEPTED/DECLINED. Read-only.

items.title: Observe open participant requests (owner)
items.details: Firestore accessRequests whereEqualTo(project, id). Read-only.

items.title: Project tab badges
items.details: Indicators GatewayPermission(count of api_client_name_asking), ParticipantRequests(count), ProjectFileModified, gateway sensor values not viewed.

items.title: Show 'controlled by thermostat' state
items.details: Params(deviceId) -> RtrConnectionMode(isConnectedToRtr, rtrDeviceNames) derived from CDB subscriptions; disables some parameters in the UI (rtr_connection_parameter_info_text).

items.title: Observe one scene
items.details: Params(sceneId). Read-only.

items.title: Observe scene infos of a device
items.details: Params(deviceId): SceneInfoEntity rows (timer scenes). Read-only.

items.title: Observe scenes
items.details: Params(filter SceneFilter All|AllInNetwork|Device(address)|IsFavorite). Read-only; timer scenes ('TimerScene ...') hidden from All.

items.title: Observe scheduler meta info
items.details: Params(deviceId): SchedulerMetaInfoEntity rows. Read-only.

items.title: Auto export/import on changes
items.details: Any local change -> 5 s debounce -> ExportProjectToCloudStorage + ExportProjectToGateway; remote change -> ImportProjectFromCloudStorage; dirty project status -> ForceImport ('Project status is dirty').

items.title: Derive threshold targets
items.details: Params(deviceId): targets = loads whose 0x1000 server subscribes to the socket's element group (CDB). Read-only.

items.title: Observe project members
items.details: Firestore projects/<id>/members {provisionerId, role, name, deviceManufacturer, deviceModel}. Read-only.

items.title: Scan QR and check project
items.details: Params(qrCode): Base64 decode -> ProjectQrCode; callable checkProjectExists {projectId} -> {exists}; ProjectNotFound(id).

items.title: Poll gateway status; re-read credentials on failure
items.details: (simple-mode) While a gateway exists: GetGatewayConfig every 5 s; on error wait 10 s; on HTTP 503 ServiceNotAvailable / 404 NotFound / 401 AuthorizationRequired re-request 0xC001-0xC003 over mesh (CommunicateWithDevice REQUEST of the gateway's credential capability) and continue. 'Stop polling of gateway config. No gateway in project'.

items.title: Create/select mesh network and provisioner
items.details: Params CreateNetworkIfNotExist: new Nordic network (defaults 'nRF Mesh Network', NetKey 'Network Key 1', AppKeys 'Application Key 1..3'), provisioner named Settings.Secure.ANDROID_ID with ranges (net:range:*), 'New network. Create default groups and device type groups' -> 5 default rooms + DeviceTypeGroupRepository.D1 (groups 0xFEF5..0xFEF9 'device type group #<dec>'); ResetProvisioners; SelectUserProvisioner -> T1(name, uuid) select own provisioner by UUID, update user provisionerId; missing -> NoProvisionerFoundForUserException (user removed from project).

items.title: Remove publications/subscriptions (connection removal primitive)
items.details: Params variants: AllConnections(deviceId, elementAddress, shouldKeepExcludedModel) -> for every model on the element (except 0x1100, 0x0527:1013, 0x0527:1011 when keepExcluded) publication := 0x0000 (ConfigModelPublicationSet) and ConfigModelSubscriptionDelete for each subscribed address; GroupConnection(deviceId, groupAddress, elementAddress, elementGroupAddress) -> subscription deletes of the room address (and linked element groups) + deleteGroupConnection (unsubscribe room loads from the key's element group, drop KeyModeGroupConfig); SceneConnection(deviceId, sceneNumber) -> drops key->scene links whose cached KeyModeSceneConfig.sceneId matches; SensorConnection(deviceId) -> 0x1100 publication := 0x0000; SpecificConnection(deviceId, meshModelIds, addresses, shouldDeleteConfig) -> targeted subscription deletes (RTR multi-connection, time keeper). Never resets KeyMode/KeyModeSceneConfig/KeySetPropertyMode properties.

items.title: Remove device locally
items.details: Params ForDevicesWithUUID(deviceUUID) / ForDevicesWithMacAddress(macAddress): delete device info, scheduler meta, element groups, room membership, scenes, properties, timers, then meshNetwork.deleteNode. No mesh message.

items.title: Remove one device from one scene
items.details: (simple-mode) Params(deviceId, sceneNumber): RemoveConnectionForAddress.SceneConnection (drop key->scene links for this scene); vendor node: SceneActionSetupGet(scene) (D6 27 05) on every channel; if a sibling channel still holds an action -> SceneActionSetupSet(scene, NoAction 0) on this channel only; else SceneDelete (0x829E, [scene u16]) to the Scene Setup Server element; delete SceneInfo row.

items.title: Remove CDB nodes without a device
items.details: If enabled and no BLE process: node UUIDs in the mesh that have no app device -> RemoveDevice.ForDevicesWithUUID (local only).

items.title: Wipe all local project data
items.details: Clears every Room table / repository ('Remove all local data!') and re-runs PrepareMeshNetwork(CreateNetworkIfNotExist).

items.title: Remove RTR -> actuator link
items.details: Params(deviceIdentifier=load, rtrDeviceIdentifier, connectionGroupAddress): if no other RTR drives the load (IsAnyRtrDeviceConnected) Admin Set 0x1014 RtrOperationMode=FALSE and verify; RemoveConnectionForAddress.SpecificConnection(load, [0x1000], [rtrElementGroup]) = ConfigModelSubscriptionDelete; verify the GenericOnOffServer is no longer subscribed ('is still subscribed to' error).

items.title: Remove a user from a synced project
items.details: Params(id): deletes the Firestore member document (own user -> RemoveLocalData). No provisioner removal and no key refresh.

items.title: Re-provision an existing device in place
items.details: Params(deviceUUID, deviceAddress, isUnprovisionedDevice). Steps ScanForUnprovisionedDevice (60 s) -> RemoveDevice -> ProvisioningDevice (IdentifyDevice + DeviceProvisioning) -> ConfigureDevice(requestButtonLayout=true) -> UpdateDeviceName (restore previous names) -> Finished. Used by layout changes and forced firmware updates.

items.title: Read one JH schedule slot
items.details: Params(schedulerIndex, deviceId): JH Scheduler Get sub-command Schedule 0 for that index (JHSchedulerScheduleCapability).

items.title: Read all JH schedules of a device
items.details: Params All(deviceId, ignoreCache) / SchedulerIndex(deviceId, schedulerIndex): JH Scheduler Get (D2 27 05) sub 15 ScheduleList [F0][centralScheduleId 0] -> 16 x 2-bit status; per used slot Get EffectiveTime (sub 2) and Action (sub 1).

items.title: Read lock-function configuration of a key
items.details: Params(deviceId, rockers): per rocker REQUEST Admin Get 0x5006 KeySetPropertyMode and 0x5007 KeySetPropertyValueUpOn (errors 'Request KeySetPropertyMode failed' / 'Request KeySetPropertyValueUpOnCapability failed'); used to classify a key as lock-function connection.

items.title: Read manufacturer info properties
items.details: Params(deviceId): SIG Generic Manufacturer Property Get (0x822B) of 0x0011 name, 0x001A software version, 0x0010 hardware revision to the 0x1012 element; STM32 devices also LBC Manufacturer Get 0x0005. Error NotManufacturerCompatible.

items.title: Reset (remove) a device from the network
items.details: Params(deviceId, isForceReset). (simple-mode) RTR: ResetOperationMode on driven loads; DeleteThreshold for socket thresholds; if not forced: remove every publication/subscription of other devices pointing at this node's element groups (RemoveConnectionForAddress.AllConnections / SpecificConnection); ConfigNodeReset (0x8049) awaiting 0x804A; RemoveDevice.ForDevicesWithUUID; ExportProjectToCloudStorage.

items.title: Reset key property-mode configuration
items.details: Params(deviceId, rocker list). Per rocker: Admin Set 0x5006 KeySetPropertyMode = [propertyId u16 LE = 0][mode u8 = 0 STATELESS] (no wait), 0x5007 KeySetPropertyValueUpOn = empty, 0x5008 KeySetPropertyValueDownOff = empty. Precedes every device/room connection.

items.title: Reset whole network (hidden debug)
items.details: ResetDevice (Config Node Reset) for every device, then RemoveLocalData.

items.title: Clear RtrOperationMode on loads of a removed RTR
items.details: Params(deviceIdentifier=RTR): for each connected load (GetConnectedDevices) with RtrOperationMode TRUE and no other RTR connected: LBC Admin Set 0x1014 RtrOperationMode = FALSE (RtrOperationModeCapability), verify ('The RTR Operation Mode is still set!').

items.title: Revoke all API clients
items.details: POST config {"data":{"api_client_reset": true}}; gateway restarts.

items.title: Persist denormalised timer copy (meta.timer)
items.details: Params(device, timer): TimerBackwardsCompatibleEntity {id uuid, deviceId, isEnabled, index, year, month[], day, hour, minute, second, dayOfWeek[], action, scene, additionalDimInfo{value,temperature?}, additionalBlindInfo{blind,slat?}, additionalTemperatureInfo{value}} exported as meta.timer for older apps/iOS. Local/export only.

items.title: Key/detector/binary input -> device (or gateway) connection
items.details: Params DeviceParams(deviceId, publicationCapable, connectToDevice, element, keyMode?, notePosition?, rocker?) / AddressParams(deviceId, publicationCapable, connectWithAddress, waitForKeyMode). Sequence (simple-mode): targetGroup = element group of the target element (MAIN/DIM=first element, BLIND=blind GenericLevelServer element, SLAT=c2() slat element, LIGHT_TEMPERATURE=TW range start+1); ResetKeySetPropertyMode(rockers) [Admin Set 0x5006=(0,STATELESS), 0x5007=empty, 0x5008=empty]; keyMode = explicit or derived (Socket target or RTR source -> Switch 5; Blind->Move 1; TwDimming/TwoGangDimming/Dimming->Light 0; Switch/TwoGangSwitch->Switch 5; Rtr->RTR 4; else Unset -1); RemoveConnectionForAddress.AllConnections(button, element, keepExcluded=true); clients = GetModelsForDeviceConnection(CLIENTS); ConnectToAddress(button, clients, targetGroup, PUBLISH_AND_SUBSCRIBE); UpdateDeviceInfo.ClearNote if notePosition; if keyMode != Unset: LBC Admin Set 0x5003 KeyMode (C3 27 05, u8); DeviceParams with rocker: ConfigurePublicationsForPropertyUser([button,target], rocker). Nothing is written on the target. Gateway link = DeviceParams(target=gateway, Element.MAIN, KeyMode Gateway 6).

items.title: Key/detector/binary input -> room connection
items.details: Params KeyModeParams(deviceId, publicationCapable, group, function, rocker) / PropertyModeParams(... -> KeyMode Property 3). Sequence: ownGroup = element group of the button element; ResetKeySetPropertyMode; RemoveConnectionForAddress.GroupConnection(button, ownGroup, element) + AllConnections(button, element, true); clients=GetModels(keyMode, CLIENTS); SetGroupFunction(button, element, room.address, publishAddress=ownGroup, function, keyMode) [room loads subscribe to ownGroup + KeyModeGroupConfig stored]; ConnectToAddress(button, clients, ownGroup, PUBLISH_AND_SUBSCRIBE); Admin Set 0x5003 KeyMode.

items.title: Subscribe room loads to a key's element group
items.details: Params(deviceId=button, elementAddress, groupAddress=room, connectionGroup=publishAddress (button element group), function, keyMode). Loads room devices, filters by function (LIGHT*->LampDevice, BLIND*->BlindDevice, SWITCH*->SocketDevice, LIGHT_AND_SWITCH*->lamp or socket, RTR_PROPERTY_MODE->RtrDevice), picks those whose server models (GetModels SERVER for keyMode, first element) are not yet subscribed (getDevicesNotSubscribed) -> ConfigModelSubscriptionAdd(loadElement, connectionGroup, model) each; stores KeyModeGroupConfig(elementAddress, groupAddress, publishAddress, function) via UpdateDeviceData.UpdateGroupConfig.

items.title: Key -> locking function (lock / lock-out protection / wind alarm)
items.details: Params DeviceParams(deviceId, publication, rocker, deviceToLock, lockingFunction, duration) / GroupParams(..., group, function). Per rocker: Admin Set 0x5006 KeySetPropertyMode=(0x0009 EnforceOutput, STATEFUL); 0x5007 KeySetPropertyValueUpOn = LockFunction value for the chosen LockingFunction [cmd u8][priority u8][time u16 LE s][...] (lock 02 01 <s>, lock-out 02 FE <s>, wind alarm 01 FF 00 00 00 00); 0x5008 KeySetPropertyValueDownOff = unlock value; then SetDeviceConnection.DeviceParams(Element.MAIN, KeyMode Property 3) or SetGroupConnection.PropertyModeParams(function *_PROPERTY_MODE); finally REQUEST Admin Get 0x0009 on the target. (simple-mode; g() not decompiled in default mode)

items.title: RTR -> heating actuators (multi connection)
items.details: (simple-mode SetMultiConnection$work$1) Params(deviceIdentifier=RTR, selectedItems). For each selected load (DeviceFilter.ConnectToRTRDevices = relay outputs: switch lamps, measure lamps, sockets): GetModels(firstElement, Switch 5, SERVER) -> ConnectToAddress(load, [0x1000], rtrElementGroup, SUBSCRIBE_ONLY); Admin Set 0x1014 RtrOperationMode=TRUE on the load; finally SetDeviceConnection.AddressParams(rtr, rtr.publication, rtrElement, waitForKeyMode=false) so the RTR's 0x1001 client publishes to its own element group. Emits Steps(currentStep,totalStep) and End(notConnectedDevices).

items.title: Proxy filter setup on connect
items.details: ProxyConfigSetFilterType(BLACK_LIST) to 0x0000 (empty black list = accept everything); optional address list. Error WrongProxySettings.

items.title: Binary input -> RTR operating mode (Eco|Comfort, Auto|Manu)
items.details: Params DeviceParams(connectionType, deviceId, binaryInputs, binaryInputNumber, rtrDevice) / GroupParams(..., group). ConnectionType AUTO_MANU(0) -> property 0x1246 SchedulerEnabled: KeySetPropertyMode=(0x1246, STATEFUL), UpOn=FALSE (presence: MANU), DownOff=TRUE (absence: AUTO); ECO_COMFORT(1) -> property 0x120B RtrHvacMode: KeySetPropertyMode=(0x120B, STATEFUL), UpOn=Comfort, DownOff=Eco. If the input is not BOTH: Admin Set 0x5009 InputEdgeDetection on the input element. Then SetGroupConnection.PropertyModeParams(function RTR_PROPERTY_MODE) or SetDeviceConnection.DeviceParams(Element.MAIN, KeyMode Property 3). Offered only for mini-actuator inputs; room must contain an RTR with HvacMode support; firmware update may be required (connection_temperature_update_required_dialog).

items.title: Key/binary input -> scene connection
items.details: Params(deviceId, publicationCapable, scene, connectToAddress=own load element). ownLoadGroup=element group of connectToAddress; keyMode Scene 2; RemoveConnectionForAddress.AllConnections(button, element, true); ConnectToAddress(button, [0x1205 SceneClient], 0xFFFF, PUBLISH_ONLY); LBC Admin Set 0x5002 KeyModeSceneConfig = [sceneNumber u16 LE][transitionTime u32 LE ms = 0] (TransitionTime immediate; waitForStatus); Admin Set 0x5003 KeyMode = 2 (no wait); cache KeyModeSceneConfig(sceneId, publishAddress=ownLoadGroup, transition) in MeshPropertyRepository/KeyModeSceneConfigEntity.

items.title: Store devices' current state into a scene
items.details: Params(deviceIds, sceneNumber, sceneItems): per device SceneStore (0x8246, [scene u16 LE], acked -> SceneRegisterStatus 0x8245) to the element of the node's first 0x1204 Scene Setup Server (primary element); if the device's element has 0x0527:1017: vendor SceneActionSetupSet (D8 27 05) [scene u16][actionType u8][5-byte payload] to that channel element with JHSceneAction Switching 1 [onoff], Lightness 2 [u16], LightnessAndCTL 3 [u16][u16 K], BlindsAndSlatsPosition 4 [s16][s16], TargetTemperature 5 [u16 x100]; SceneInfoEntity row with captured values. Error CreateSceneFailed(deviceNames).

items.title: Participant access request
items.details: Params(projectQrCode): callable createNewAccessRequest {projectId, deviceManufacturer, deviceModel, name} (Firestore accessRequests, status PENDING).

items.title: Enable/disable JH schedule
items.details: Params(deviceId, schedulerIndex, toggleToActive): 2-byte type-only JH Scheduler Set [index|sub 0][type]: TimedActive 3 <-> TimedInactive 2, SunriseActive 5 <-> 4, SunsetActive 7 <-> 6 ('Cannot toggle JHSchedulerType' otherwise).

items.title: Enable/disable threshold
items.details: Params TurnOnThreshold(deviceId,isActive) / TurnOffThreshold(deviceId,isActive): Admin Set 0x5004/0x5005 with active byte changed, value kept.

items.title: Update device metadata (name, MAC, group config)
items.details: Params UpdateDeviceName(deviceId, deviceName) [CheckNameInput DEVICE, auto suffix for duplicates; only meta.devices[].name, CDB node name never changed], UpdateDeviceAddress(deviceId, macAddress), UpdateGroupConfig(deviceId, KeyModeGroupConfig) -> DeviceEntity.keyModeGroupConfigs (= meta.devices[].cachedGroupConnectionMetadata). No mesh message.

items.title: Update local device info (notes, consumption display)
items.details: Params incl. ClearNote(position) and note/consumption settings -> DeviceInfoEntity(positionNotes map keyPosition->text max 300 chars, isConsumptionInfoVisible, pricePerCent, syncLeds, ...). Local only, not exported. Gateway-link keys show the note.

items.title: Minimal configuration before a forced firmware update
items.details: Params(uuid): ProxySetFilterType BLACK_LIST, ConfigCompositionDataGet, ConfigAppKeyAdd, ConfigDefaultTtlSet(5), ConfigGattProxySet(1).

items.title: Central functions (all lamps/sockets/blinds/RTRs) and room dim/stop
items.details: One unacknowledged message per call (c.a.b(..., uuid null)). Params: Toggle.Lamps(onOff) GenericOnOffSetUnack -> 0xFEF5; Toggle.Sockets -> 0xFEF8; Dim.Lamps(pct) LightLightnessSetUnack -> 0xFEF5; Dim.Group(address,pct) -> room address; Move.Blinds(pct) GenericLevelSetUnack -> 0xFEF6; Move.Slats -> 0xFEF7; OpenClose.Blinds(levelStep) / OpenClose.Group(address) GenericDeltaSet (0 = stop) -> 0xFEF6 / room; TargetTemperature.Rtrs(degC) GenericLevelSetUnack -> 0xFEF9 with pct=(t-5)/25*100. No transition, TTL default.

items.title: Apply stored scene values to device model
items.details: Params(device, sceneInfo): maps SceneInfo (onOff, lightness %, TW %, blind/slat %, temperature) onto capabilities for display/editing. Local only.

items.title: Store gateway IP override
items.details: Params(deviceIdentifier, gatewayIP): updates the gateway device's cached IP capability (manual IP), used for the REST base URL.

items.title: Gateway IP settings
items.details: Params(dhcp, ipAddress, subnetMask, dns): POST config {"data":{"ip_dhcp":b, "ip_address", "ip_subnet", "ip_dns"}} (strings null when DHCP).

items.title: Rename room / change room icon
items.details: Params UpdateName(groupAddress, name) -> Room upsert + Nordic group.setName/updateGroup; UpdateIcon(groupAddress, groupIcon) -> Room only (GroupIcon, 32 values ic_group_*). No mesh message.

items.title: POST project file to gateway
items.details: Params(projectFile: ExportDto): POST config {"data":{"project_file": <ExportDto>}}.

items.title: Change scene icon
items.details: Params(sceneNumber, sceneIcon): Room only (meta.scenes[].icon).

items.title: Rename scene
items.details: Params(sceneNumber, newName): CheckNameInput(SCENE) case-insensitive unique; Room + Nordic Scene.setName. No mesh message.

items.title: Edit SIG timer
items.details: Params(deviceId, timer, capable, updateToHour/Minute/DayOfWeek/Action/AstroTimer, locationPoint): SceneRecall timers re-store their timer scene (StoreDeviceConfigurationInScene), then send as UpdateTimerStatus(activate) + SaveTimerBackwardsCompatible.

items.title: Set Time Role of a device
items.details: Params(deviceId, timeRole): TimeRoleCapability -> Time Role Set (0x8239) on the 0x1201 Time Setup Server element with role None 0 / MeshTimeAuthority 1 / MeshTimeRelay 2 / MeshTimeClient 3. Error UpdateTimeRoleError.

items.title: Enable/disable/send SIG timer
items.details: Params(deviceId, timer, capable, activate, timerAction, astroTimer, locationPoint, saveBackwardsCompatible): Admin Set 7 (astro register or static default mode 0, 31:00/31:00, offset 0); optional Location Set; SchedulerActionSet with action = NoAction 15 (disable, other fields unchanged) or the stored action (enable); SchedulerMetaInfo kept while disabled.

items.title: Update user name/role (admin/member mode)
items.details: Params UpdateName(userId, name) -> Firestore members/<uid>.name; UpdateRole(projectId, role): OWNER -> force import from cloud then callable assumeOwnerRole {projectId} -> {newOwner, previousOwner}; MEMBER -> members/<uid>.role='member'; UpdateLocalRole / UpdateLastKnownRole -> prefs local_user_role / last_known_user_role. Errors InvalidName / InvalidRole.

items.title: Central control sheet (home and per room)
items.details: Tabs RTR / SOCKET / LAMP / BLIND, only for classes present. Home: UpdateDeviceTypeGroup (unack to 0xFEF5..0xFEF9). Inside a room: per-device CommunicateWithDevice unicast (unack) fan-out for on/off, blind position, slats, RTR; dim and blind stop via UpdateDeviceTypeGroup Dim.Group / OpenClose.Group to the room address. Strings central_function_*.

items.title: Connection categories per source
items.details: Detector -> Device, Group; push-button key -> Device, Group, Scene, Gateway (+ Locking functions for LEFT/RIGHT/CENTER); mini-actuator input -> Switching, Light, Temperature, Hangings, Group, Scene, Gateway, Locking functions; 'No function' removes the connection (RemoveConnectionForAddress: GroupConnection for room/group-lock links, AllConnections otherwise; KeyMode not reset).

items.title: Room functions offered per source
items.details: Keys/inputs: LIGHT, BLIND, SWITCH, LIGHT_AND_SWITCH (strings group_function_light/blind/switch/light_and_switch); detectors: LIGHT, SWITCH, LIGHT_AND_SWITCH; RTR mode links: RTR_PROPERTY_MODE (room must contain an RTR, connection_temperature_no_rtr_dialog).

items.title: Temperature connections for mini-actuator inputs
items.details: Temperature control (input drives RTR set-point, KeyMode RTR 4 via ConfigureMiniActuatorConnection), Eco|Comfort and Auto|Manu (SetRtrPropertyConnection) to an RTR device or a room. Not offered for push-button keys.

items.title: Gateway link note per key
items.details: Free-text note (max 300) stored in DeviceInfoEntity.positionNotes only for keys connected to the gateway; strings gateway_connection_* explain key naming A/B/C/D and E1/E2 in IoT systems.

items.title: Project handover / share via file / import file
items.details: Share project file (ACTION_SEND of JungHome.json) and Import project file (ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT, .json only); hidden while cloud sync is on; backup prompt (project_backup_*) when enabling sync.

items.title: Scene register capacity check
items.details: Vendor multi-channel node: SceneActionSetupGet(0) list -> < 8 scenes per channel; else SceneRegisterGet -> < 16; timer scenes count too (scenes_no_capacity_* / SCENES_AND_AUTOMATION).

items.title: JH vs SIG scheduler selection
items.details: device.X1(): device's own element has 0x0527:1016 -> JH scheduler UI (schedules/*); else SIG scheduler (timer/*). 16 automations per device (scheduler_register_no_capacity_*). Scene 'Automation' button opens a member device's timer editor (scene_scheduling_*).
